column2: Lilmoth Dock is a short walk north-east of here. The walled part of Lilmoth, which the map marks as Lolmoth, lies a little further off to the north-north-west. Hereguard Plantation lies further still to the west-north-west. Bretons hold it.
This is my village, and I am Flaa Heet, its headman. Three villagers and a child live here with me, and two of them sell from stalls.
Sword ferns crowd the slope east of the village.
Lilmoth has no single ruler. A council of powerful merchants runs the town.
Lilmoth is built over shallow water, so large ships cannot dock. They anchor out, and small boats bring the goods in. The town has its own Hist tree, though no tribe of its own.
Three dead Dunmer lie at the east end of Lilmoth Dock, a man and two women. They lie unburied, and their gear is still on them.
I am Flaa Heet. I lead the families who live here, outside the walls of Lilmoth. We fish, gather leeks and keep our stores in barrels. I have no seat on the council and want none.
